_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score ~40 sits inside Anxiety with flat-to-down 30d coil; post-OPEX move is tactical risk-off not a proven ±2 breaker, so rung and leg hold.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD forward inside Anxiety; narrative silent on phase but risk-off tone consistent; no bullish disagreement
next_move.confirmed_if: Next 12h BTC inside ±1.5% and fear_greed 25-40 with no exit from Anxiety band
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed <=24 on >1.5% flush (toward Denial/Panic) or >=46 with 30d momentum >60 (toward Complacency)
